inputs.statement:
LOAD SaleID, Customer, SaleDate,
     Num#(AmountText, '#,##0.00') AS Amount,
     SubField(Path, '/', 3) AS Country,
     KeepChar(Code, '0123456789') AS CodeDigits,
     Round(Num#(AmountText, '#,##0.00'), 10) AS AmountRounded,
     Class(Num#(AmountText, '#,##0.00'), 500) AS AmountBand

output.sql: SELECT "src"."SaleID" AS "SaleID","src"."Customer" AS "Customer","src"."SaleDate" AS "SaleDate",CAST(REPLACE("src"."AmountText",',','') AS DOUBLE) AS "Amount",SPLIT_PART("src"."Path",'/',3) AS "Country",REGEXP_REPLACE("src"."Code","[^0-9]","") AS "CodeDigits",ROUND(CAST(REPLACE("src"."AmountText",',','') AS DOUBLE) / 10) * 10 AS "AmountRounded",CONCAT(CAST(FLOOR(CAST(REPLACE("src"."AmountText",',','') AS DOUBLE) / 500) * 500 AS VARCHAR),' <= ',CASE WHEN CAST(REPLACE("src"."AmountText",',','') AS DOUBLE) = FLOOR(CAST(REPLACE("src"."AmountText",',','') AS DOUBLE)) THEN CAST(FLOOR(CAST(REPLACE("src"."AmountText",',','') AS DOUBLE)) AS VARCHAR) ELSE CAST(CAST(REPLACE("src"."AmountText",',','') AS DOUBLE) AS VARCHAR) END,' < ',CAST(FLOOR(CAST(REPLACE("src"."AmountText",',','') AS DOUBLE) / 500) * 500 + 500 AS VARCHAR)) AS "AmountBand" FROM src
